name: The Cradle of Sealed Gods & Six Races
core_rationale: Establishes the Multi-Race & Sealed-God cosmology across four canonical chapters (1.1 Creation, 1.2 Age Of The Gods, 1.3 The God Wars, 1.4 God Seal Magic by The Architect), binding six playable/mob races to racial home towns with dedicated hunting and farming loops, six monster-only ecology races, neutral Adventure Guild & Blacksmith Clan hubs, and the strict God > MVP (God Subordinate) > Raid Boss hierarchy.

causal_continuity.evidence: All four history chapters (1.1 Creation -> 1.2 Age Of The Gods -> 1.3 The God Wars -> 1.4 God Seal Magic by The Architect) trace directly into the 3 Continents, 6 Racial Home Towns, and the God > MVP > Raid Boss hierarchy.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: Every continent is anchored by a sealed God-Tier entity and a Great War scar: Hearthbloom Basin glazed kiln caldera, the Clockwork Steppe giant brass faultline, and the Shattered Halo inverted-gravity sky islands.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: Enforces the 0.90 to 1.20 meter chibi/miniature proportion standard (1.05m reference height, 2.0x1.5m doors, <=0.15m stairs, <=0.35m grass, >=3.5m roads, 0.55-0.65m counters) across all 6 racial home towns.

spatial_and_ecological_consistency.evidence: Players begin in their chosen Race Home Town with a race-specific story, open-portal adjacent hunting ground, and resource farming loop, then converge through the Neutral Adventure Guild and Blacksmith Clan.

intentional_mystery_discipline.evidence: The Architect final God Seal Vaults and the awakening of each Sealed God top-tier MVP Apostle remain locked behind fog-of-lore catacombs and multi-race Main Quest keys.

character_scale_law.head_to_body_ratio: 1:2.3 cute toddler and kid proportions with chunky boots, clear silhouettes, and expressive oversized backpacks and lanterns
silhouette_rules: Headgear, ears, and backpack props must read clearly at 12 meter camera distance against ground terrain.
Ground foliage never exceeds knee height (0.35 meters) in traversal lanes; bushes never exceed chest height (0.65 meters).

player_arrival_premise.player_identity: A newly awakened scion of one of the Six Mortal Races—Human/Demi-Human, Lunar, Ogre/Orc, Dark-Lunar, Dwarf, or Furral—bearing a resonant fragment of The Architect's God Seal.
player_arrival_premise.why_enter_world: Each adventurer begins in their race's ancestral Home Town to master their racial craft, hunt encroaching monsters, farm regional alloys, and register with the Neutral Adventure Guild.
player_arrival_premise.inciting_phenomenon: Hairline fractures have appeared across the God Seals forged by The Architect in Chapter 1.4, awakening top-tier MVP Apostles (direct subordinates of the Sealed Gods) and lesser Raid Boss wardens across all three continents.

primordial_gods.name: Aethelgard, The Architect
primordial_gods.title: The Mortal Woman Who Sealed Every God
primordial_gods.core_rationale: A mortal human woman of unmatched geometric and runic genius who ended the devastating God Wars (Chapter 1.3) by forging the nationwide array of God Seal Magic (Chapter 1.4), binding every deity—Angel, Demon, Legendary Beast, Leviathan, and the Three-Element Legendary Dragon—beneath the world's continents.
primordial_gods.domain: God Seal Magic, Sacred Geometry, and Mortal Sovereignty
primordial_gods.geographical_scar: The Prime Seal Meridians that link Lantern Hollow, Inductor Switchyard, and Starfall Haven into a planetary containment lattice
primordial_gods.architectural_imprint: Octagonal seal-keystones, runic obelisks, and 0.60-meter calibration pedestals found in every racial starter town

primordial_gods.name: Seraphiel of the Zenith Choir
primordial_gods.title: The Sealed Celestial Arbiter (Angel)
primordial_gods.core_rationale: Commander of the high-altitude celestial hosts during the Age of the Gods; sealed by The Architect inside the prism-bells of the Shattered Halo after judging mortal cities unworthy of free will.
primordial_gods.domain: Radiant Law, Starlight Judgement, and Harmonic Bells
primordial_gods.geographical_scar: The Inverted Belfry and luminous prism reefs of Continent 03 where celestial feathers calcified into starlight glass
primordial_gods.architectural_imprint: Winged alabaster archways, suspended chime-spires, and Lunar starlight sanctums

primordial_gods.name: Malphas of the Abyssal Crucible
primordial_gods.title: The Sealed Cinder Tyrant (Demon)
primordial_gods.core_rationale: Lord of the abyssal slag-fiends who clashed with Seraphiel during the God Wars; bound by The Architect's chains beneath the deepest kiln-trenches and shadow refraction crypts.
primordial_gods.domain: Abyssal Hellfire, Blood-Obsidian, and Shadow Refraction
primordial_gods.geographical_scar: The umbral obsidian fissures beneath Kilnwatch Bastion and the Shadow Refraction Crypts
primordial_gods.architectural_imprint: Basalt horn-buttresses, dark-prism containment seals, and Ogre crucible bastions

primordial_gods.name: fenrir-kael, The World-Prowler
primordial_gods.title: The Sealed Sovereign of Fang & Root (Legendary Beast)
primordial_gods.mvp_apostle_title: Alpha Electro-Stalker Raijin-Vex (MVP — Direct Beast Subordinate)
primordial_gods.core_rationale: Progenitor of all wild fauna and patron totem of the Furral warrior tribes; sealed by The Architect within the amber-root and thunder-coil ley canyons so its primal roar would no longer shatter continents.
primordial_gods.domain: Primal Savagery, Bio-Static Pulse, and World-Root Canopies
primordial_gods.geographical_scar: The giant claw-cut canyons of the Amber-Root Hollows and Thunder-Coil Basin
primordial_gods.architectural_imprint: Fang-arch totems, braided root-bridges, and Furral copper-inductor arenas

primordial_gods.name: Thalassor the Trench-Swallower
primordial_gods.title: The Sealed Abyssal Tidemaster (Leviathan)
primordial_gods.core_rationale: Colossal serpent of the primordial ocean whose thrashing during the God Wars tore whole archipelagos into the sky; sealed by The Architect beneath the upward waterfalls of the Perigee Abyss.
primordial_gods.domain: Crushing Abyssal Tides, Upward Maelstroms, and Pelagic Bioluminescence
primordial_gods.geographical_scar: The inverted whirlpool and upward-falling ocean cascades of the Shattered Halo
primordial_gods.architectural_imprint: Barnacle-clad brass diving bells, coral lock-gates, and siphon aqueducts

primordial_gods.name: Bahamut-Triad, The Threefold Wyrm
primordial_gods.title: The Sealed Dragon of Earth, Fire & Thunder
primordial_gods.mvp_apostle_title: Tri-Scale Wyrm-Marshal Volcanor (MVP — Direct Dragon Subordinate)
primordial_gods.core_rationale: Three-headed primordial dragon embodying tectonic Earth, kiln Fire, and galvanic Thunder; sealed by The Architect across the tri-continental faultlines where the Blacksmith Clan now taps its dormant elemental breath.
primordial_gods.domain: Tectonic Earth, Crucible Fire, and Galvanic Thunder
primordial_gods.geographical_scar: The tri-elemental vein network feeding Hearthbloom's kilns, the Clockwork Steppe's thunder-coils, and the Blacksmith Clan's master anvils
primordial_gods.architectural_imprint: Dragon-jaw forge flues, triple-alloy anvils, and grounded lightning spires

primordial_gods.name: Sola the Hearth-Weaver
primordial_gods.title: Sealed Earth-Fire Aspect of the Kiln Basin
primordial_gods.core_rationale: Regional Earth-and-Fire aspect sealed inside Hearthbloom Basin's central ceramic caldera; her dormant warmth keeps Continent 01 at perpetual spring for Human and Dwarf starter towns.
primordial_gods.domain: Warm Clay, Perpetual Spring, and Hearth-Fires
primordial_gods.geographical_scar: The Great Glazed Caldera of Hearthbloom Basin (scar-kiln-basin)
primordial_gods.architectural_imprint: Rounded terracotta domes, chimney-spire lanterns, and glazed brick bridges

primordial_gods.name: Krono the Brass Titan
primordial_gods.title: Sealed Thunder-Forge Aspect of the Steppe
primordial_gods.mvp_apostle_title: Chrono-Vanguard Aegis-IX (MVP — Direct Brass Titan Subordinate)
primordial_gods.core_rationale: Colossal clockwork colossus of the God Wars sealed by The Architect along the Brass Faultline of Continent 02, powering wind-tinker hubs and Furral inductor switchyards.
primordial_gods.domain: Wind-Gears, Galvanic Springs, and Perpetual Motion
primordial_gods.geographical_scar: The Brass Faultline (scar-brass-faultline) across the Clockwork Steppe
primordial_gods.architectural_imprint: Interlocking copper gear-plazas, wind-vane towers, and railway viaducts

primordial_gods.name: Vesper the Dream-Eater
primordial_gods.title: Sealed Astral-Tide Aspect of the Halo
primordial_gods.core_rationale: Astral-and-Leviathan aspect sealed inside the inverted-gravity crater of Continent 03, where Lunar and Dark-Lunar citadels harvest starlight and umbral refraction.
primordial_gods.domain: Starlight Tides, Inverted Gravity, and Memory Glass
primordial_gods.geographical_scar: The Shattered Halo (scar-vesper-crater) suspended above the northern whirlpool
primordial_gods.architectural_imprint: Tethered floating piers, stained-glass astrolabes, and upside-down waterfalls

historical_epochs.name: 1.1 Creation — The Primordial Crucible & Birth of the Twelve Lineages
historical_epochs.core_rationale: Out of the primordial elemental crucible emerged the landmasses, oceans, and the twelve living lineages: six sentient mortal races (Human/Demi-Human, Lunar, Ogre/Orc, Dark-Lunar, miniature high-strength Dwarf, and electro-warrior Furral) alongside six wild monster ecologies (Beast/Brute, Robotic cores, Undead husks, Fish, Insect/Arachnia, and sentient Plant flora).

world_scars.name: The Primordial Amber & Elemental Veins
world_scars.description: Deep subterranean veins of earth-clay, thunder-amber, and star-quartz formed at Creation, later tapped by the six racial home towns and the Blacksmith Clan.

historical_epochs.name: 1.2 Age Of The Gods — Dominion of the Five Divine Orders
historical_epochs.core_rationale: Before mortal self-rule, the five divine orders—Angel (Seraphiel), Demon (Malphas), Legendary Beast (Fenrir-Kael), Leviathan (Thalassor), and the Threefold Legendary Dragon (Earth, Fire, Thunder)—claimed absolute dominion over the skies, seas, and faultlines, elevating chosen Apostles as top-tier MVP commanders over the mortal races.

world_scars.name: The Five Divine Citadel Foundations
world_scars.description: Monumental divine thrones and elemental conduits raised during the Age of the Gods, now serving as high-level MVP Boss sanctums.

historical_epochs.name: 1.3 The God Wars — Clash of Pantheons & Shattering of the Continents
historical_epochs.core_rationale: Total war erupted between Angel, Demon, Legendary Beast, Leviathan, and the Three-Element Legendary Dragon (alongside regional aspects Sola, Krono, and Vesper). Their cataclysmic weapons fractured the world into three continents, spawning war-construct Raid Bosses and threatening to annihilate all six mortal races.

world_scars.name: The Great Glazed Caldera
world_scars.description: Where Sola's ceramic shield and the Earth-Fire Dragon's breath fused the western valley into warm terracotta terraces and boiling sap cisterns.

world_scars.name: The Brass Faultline
world_scars.description: A 400-kilometer canyon of giant exposed clockwork gears, thunder-coils, and ticking copper ribs across the eastern steppe.

world_scars.name: The Shattered Halo
world_scars.description: An inverted-gravity archipelago of basalt and coral islands suspended above a glowing maelstrom where Angel, Demon, and Leviathan clashed.

historical_epochs.name: 1.4 God Seal Magic — Every God Sealed by The Architect
historical_epochs.core_rationale: Rising from the ashes of the God Wars, a mortal human woman known as The Architect (Aethelgard) wove the supreme God Seal Magic. She bound every single God—Angel, Demon, Legendary Beast, Leviathan, and the Legendary Dragon—into slumbering vaults beneath the world, allowing the six mortal races to build their Racial Home Towns, establish the Neutral Adventure Guild, and unite the Blacksmith Clan.

world_scars.name: The Architect's Planetary Seal Lattice
world_scars.description: A network of runic seal-anchors beneath every racial home town and catacomb dungeon; while the Gods remain sealed, their direct MVP subordinates and lesser Raid Boss wardens now strain against the locks.

playable_and_mob_races.name: Human / Demi-Human
playable_and_mob_races.archetype_reference: Versatile heirs of The Architect runic geometry and adaptive Demi-Human kin
playable_and_mob_races.niched_story: Awakening in Lantern Hollow (Lv.1-10), Human and Demi-Human initiates defend the First Meridian Keystone before marching east through Kiln East Orchard at Lv.10 to join all six races at Kilnwatch Bastion for guilding and party quests.
playable_and_mob_races.combat_trait: Balanced Seal-Resonance: +10% adaptability to all weapon classes and Job Quest mastery.

playable_and_mob_races.name: Dwarf (Tontatta-Lineage Micro-Titans)
playable_and_mob_races.archetype_reference: One Piece Tontatta-inspired miniature craftsmen with explosive superhuman strength and botanical-mechanical mastery
playable_and_mob_races.niched_story: Tiny, super-strong Dwarf smith-scouts start in Root-Train Roundhouse (Lv.1-10) clearing insectoid swarms from the banyan root-railways, then ride the resin-arch line to Kilnwatch Bastion at Lv.10-20 to forge multi-race guild gear.
playable_and_mob_races.combat_trait: Tontatta Mighty Impact: Miniature hitbox with colossal hammer/axe knockdown force and +15% Blacksmith forging yield.

playable_and_mob_races.name: Ogre / Orc
playable_and_mob_races.archetype_reference: Crucible-hardened Ogre and Orc vanguard clans sworn to contain the subterranean Demon and Dragon vents
playable_and_mob_races.niched_story: Ogre and Orc vanguard initiates temper their resolve at Draft-Kiln Post (Lv.1-10) in the Ash-Bellows Trench before ascending Firebrick Duct at Lv.10-20 to serve as front-line tanks for multi-race parties in Kilnwatch Bastion.
playable_and_mob_races.combat_trait: Crucible Blood-Fury: High thermal/physical fortitude and heavy cleave damage that scales as HP drops.

playable_and_mob_races.name: Furral (Electro-Beastfolk Tribe)
playable_and_mob_races.archetype_reference: One Piece Mink-inspired agile beastfolk warriors who channel bio-static Electro through fur and brass conductors
playable_and_mob_races.niched_story: Young Furral electro-warriors train atop the wind-turbines of Cinnamon-Mill Haven (Lv.1-10), harvesting static amber before converging at Kilnwatch Bastion & Glaze-Barge Quay (Lv.10-20) to form guilds bound for their ancestral Inductor Switchyard.
playable_and_mob_races.combat_trait: Electro Claw & Sulong Surge: Imbues melee/dash strikes with chain-lightning shock and high evasion.

playable_and_mob_races.name: Lunar (Astral High-Elven Lineage)
playable_and_mob_races.archetype_reference: Elf-like celestial navigators and starlight weavers dwelling in porcelain-mirror sanctuaries
playable_and_mob_races.niched_story: Lunar star-weavers begin their pilgrimage in Porcelain Loom Sanctuary (Lv.1-10), weaving starlight wards across Celadon Causeway before uniting with all six races at Kilnwatch Bastion (Lv.10-20) to prepare for the sky-ascension to Starfall Haven.
playable_and_mob_races.combat_trait: Astral Grace & Bow/Spell Precision: Extended ranged/spell reach and low-gravity aerial step.

playable_and_mob_races.name: Dark-Lunar (Umbral Eclipse Lineage)
playable_and_mob_races.archetype_reference: Dark-Elf-like shadow-refraction scholars and acoustic seal-watchers of the twilight belfries
playable_and_mob_races.niched_story: Dark-Lunar shadow-scholars keep vigil in Carillon Hearth Belfry (Lv.1-10) listening for Demon-seal tremors in the wind-chime canyons, then join multi-race guilds at Kilnwatch Bastion & Glaze-Barge Quay (Lv.10-20) to unlock the Umbrage Prism Atolls.
playable_and_mob_races.combat_trait: Umbral Refraction: Critical backstab/shadow-arts amplification and resistance to abyssal corruption.

monster_ecology_races.name: Beast / Animal / Brute
monster_ecology_races.ecological_niche: Wild territorial predators, glaze-shell badgers, copper-horned steppelings, and primal brutes mutated by the Sealed Legendary Beast's aura.

monster_ecology_races.name: Robotic / Clockwork Automaton
monster_ecology_races.ecological_niche: Autonomous brass sentinels, runaway escapement drones, and God War siege constructs still executing ancient directives along the Brass Faultline.

monster_ecology_races.name: Undead / Seal-Wraith
monster_ecology_races.ecological_niche: Hollowed soldiers of the God Wars, porcelain-bound crypt specters, and shadow-refracted revenants haunting catacombs near Demon and Leviathan seals.

monster_ecology_races.name: Fish / Pelagic & Sky-Tide Fauna
monster_ecology_races.ecological_niche: Glaze-river armored carp, abyssal trench leviathan-spawn, and flying starlight rays swimming through the upward waterfalls of the Shattered Halo.

monster_ecology_races.name: Insect / Arachnia
monster_ecology_races.ecological_niche: Amber-resin tunnel weavers, porcelain-carapace beetles, and copper-eating spark-spiders nesting inside root-trains and gear trenches.

monster_ecology_races.name: Plant / Sentient Flora
monster_ecology_races.ecological_niche: Spore-puffing lantern treants, spice-orchard mandrakes, and bioluminescent kelp-hydras fed by leaking God Seal mana.

god_tier_entities.name: Angel (Seraphiel of the Zenith Choir)
god_tier_entities.lore_summary: Sealed inside the Inverted Belfry of the Shattered Halo; commands celestial MVP Apostle Caelia and lesser choir Raid Bosses.

god_tier_entities.name: Demon (Malphas of the Abyssal Crucible)
god_tier_entities.lore_summary: Sealed beneath the deepest kiln-trenches and umbral crypts; his direct subordinate Dread-Lord Ignisazar reigns as a top-tier MVP Boss above dungeon Raid Bosses.

god_tier_entities.name: Legendary Beast (Fenrir-Kael the World-Prowler)
god_tier_entities.lore_summary: Sealed beneath the Amber-Root and Thunder-Coil faultlines; revered by the Furral and served by MVP Apostle Raijin-Vex.

god_tier_entities.name: Leviathan (Thalassor the Trench-Swallower)
god_tier_entities.lore_summary: Sealed beneath the Perigee Abyss maelstrom; its direct subordinate Tide-Herald Pelagios commands pelagic Raid Bosses across the sky-seas.

god_tier_entities.name: Legendary Dragon (Bahamut-Triad of Earth, Fire & Thunder)
god_tier_entities.lore_summary: Three-headed elemental dragon of Earth, Fire, and Thunder sealed across the tri-continental meridian; its breath heats the Blacksmith Clan's master forges.

god_tier_entities.name: The Architect (Aethelgard, Mortal Seal-Weaver)
god_tier_entities.sealed_by: Self-Transcended into the Planetary Seal Lattice
god_tier_entities.direct_mvp_subordinate: First Seal-Scribe Automaton, Prime Keeper (MVP Trial Arbiter)
god_tier_entities.lore_summary: The human woman who ended the God Wars in Chapter 1.4 by sealing every God with God Seal Magic and gifting the six mortal races their sovereign home towns.

blacksmith_clan.name: The Sovereign Blacksmith Clan (Six-Anvil Covenant)
blacksmith_clan.allegiance: Cross-Racial Craft Covenant (Found in all 6 Racial Home Towns)
blacksmith_clan.core_role: Transforms raw materials farmed from racial hunting/farming grounds and boss drops into weapons, armor, and God-Seal socketed gear on 0.60m chibi-scale anvils.
forging_systems: Racial Alloy Smelting (combining Human terracotta-steel, Dwarf root-iron, Ogre dragon-cinder, Furral storm-brass, and Lunar/Dark-Lunar star-glass)
Boss Core Awakening (socketing Raid Boss & MVP Apostle cores into endgame equipment)
Equipment Refinement, Durability Repair & Job-Weapon Promotion
racial_anvil_branches: Astral & Umbral Prism-Kiln (Starfall Haven & Umbrage Focal Sanctum)

adventure_guild.name: The Accord Adventure Guild
adventure_guild.neutrality_charter: Strictly neutral ('No Side') across all six playable races and all three continents. Every racial Home Town hosts an Adventure Guild hall where players trade quests, form cross-race parties, and claim bounties.
core_services: Quest Trading & Commission Board (brokering Side Quests, Material Requests, and Bounty Contracts between players and NPCs)
Cross-Race Party & Raid Matchmaking for Catacomb Raid Bosses and field MVP Apostles
Hunter Rank Licensing, Monster Compendium Registration, and Fast-Travel Charter Passes

quest_progression_loop.progression_philosophy: Players progress by weaving together three distinct quest tracks—grinding levels, farming regional materials, advancing their combat Job, and uncovering the fracturing God Seals.

tracks.name: Main Quests (The Fracturing God Seals)
tracks.purpose: Begins in the player's Racial Home Town with a race-specific crisis, then converges at the Neutral Adventure Guild to investigate the weakening of The Architect's Chapter 1.4 God Seals across all three continents.
tracks.reward_focus: Continent Travel Unlocks, Seal-Resonance Relics, and Catacomb Gate Keys

tracks.name: Job Quests (Class Mastery & Blacksmith Trials)
tracks.purpose: Issued jointly by class mentors and the Blacksmith Clan to test combat proficiency, unlock racial/class skills, and forge signature Job weapons.
tracks.reward_focus: Job Class Promotions, Signature Skill Books, and Blacksmith Masterwork Blueprints

tracks.name: Side Quests (Home Town Stories, Hunting & Farming Commissions)
tracks.purpose: Traded freely at the Neutral Adventure Guild counter—covering local racial home town stories, monster culling in adjacent hunting areas, and resource farming runs.
tracks.reward_focus: EXP Grind Efficiency, Crafting Materials, Guild Tokens, and Regional Reputation

tiers.name: God Tier (Sealed by The Architect)
tiers.cosmic_role: The 5 Sealed Gods (Angel, Demon, Legendary Beast, Leviathan, Legendary Dragon of Earth/Fire/Thunder) plus The Architect who sealed them in Chapter 1.4.
tiers.power_relationship: Transcendent cosmic entities immobilized by God Seal Magic; they cannot roam the surface directly and instead project power through their direct MVP subordinates.
tiers.loot_tier: Mythic Seal-Shards & World-Epoch Relics (Echo Trial / Seal Defense rewards)

tiers.name: MVP Boss (Top-Tier Active Sovereign — Direct Subordinate of a God)
tiers.cosmic_role: The supreme active combat threat in the world. Every MVP Boss is the direct Apostle/Subordinate of one of the Sealed Gods (e.g., Arch-Valkyrie Caelia for Angel, Dread-Lord Ignisazar for Demon, Tri-Scale Volcanor for Legendary Dragon).
tiers.power_relationship: Strictly higher than any Raid Boss (MVP > Raid Boss). Announces spawn server-wide, commands multi-phase divine mechanics, and requires elite coordinated hunters.
tiers.loot_tier: MVP God-Apostle Cards, Divine Weapon Cores, and Crown Cosmetics

tiers.name: Raid Boss (Lower Tier than MVP — Dungeon Warden / Great War Construct)
tiers.cosmic_role: Catacomb B1 seal-wardens, runaway God War siege engines, and mutated regional apex monsters guarding dungeon vaults.
tiers.power_relationship: Strictly subordinate in power and authority to MVP Bosses (Raid Boss < MVP Boss), serving as structured multi-party dungeon milestones.
tiers.loot_tier: Raid Set Armor Materials, Blacksmith Alloy Ingots, and Dungeon Seal Keys

tiers.name: Mini-Boss, Elite & Normal Monsters (12-Race Ecology)
tiers.cosmic_role: Field leaders and everyday monsters belonging to either the 6 Playable/Mob races (renegade Ogres, Dark-Lunar exiles, etc.) or the 6 Monster-only ecology races (Beast/Brute, Robotic, Undead, Fish, Insect/Arachnia, Plant).
tiers.power_relationship: Found across every Hunting Area and Farming Zone adjacent to Racial Home Towns for solo/small-party EXP and material grinding.
tiers.loot_tier: Everyday Crafting Materials, Monster Cards, Consumables, and Quest Turn-Ins

cross_race_convergence_hubs.convergence_rule: All 6 Playable Races spawn on Continent 01 (Lv.1-10) in their own Racial Home Town District and are guided by Main, Job, and Side Quests at Level 10-20 to converge at Kilnwatch Bastion (and Glaze-Barge Quay / Pinion Terminus) to form cross-race Guilds (gilding), matchmake parties, trade quests at the Neutral Adventure Guild, and smelt combined racial alloys at the Blacksmith Clan Six-Anvil Foundry.

hubs.town_name: Kilnwatch Bastion (Primary Lv.10-20 All-Race Guild & Party Citadel)
hubs.hub_role: Central Continent 01 fortress where all 6 races meet at Level 10-15 to register Guilds (gilding), form multi-race 6-player parties, trade quests at the Neutral Adventure Guild Grand Hall, and combine all 6 racial farming materials at the Sovereign Blacksmith Clan Six-Anvil Foundry.
guilding_and_party_features: Accord Guild Registration Charter (Lv.10+ Cross-Race Guild Creation, Emblem & Guild Hall)
Neutral Adventure Guild Grand Exchange (Party Finder, Bounty Board & Multi-Race Quest Trading)
Blacksmith Clan Six-Anvil Master Foundry (Requires alloys farmed from all 6 Racial Home Towns)
Direct Portal Access to Lv.10-20 Party Grinding & Catacomb Raid Bosses

hubs.town_name: Glaze-Barge Quay (Lv.15-20 Multi-Race River Guild Port)
hubs.hub_role: Secondary Level 15-20 port city where Dwarf, Lunar, Dark-Lunar, and Furral river-routes merge with Human and Ogre parties for the Sunken Potter Hold Raid Boss.
guilding_and_party_features: Guild Barge Convoy Escorts & River Delta Party Commissions (Lv.15-20)
Adventure Guild Maritime Brokerage & Cross-Race Material Market
Sunken Potter Hold B1 Catacomb Raid Staging Dock

hubs.town_name: Pinion Terminus (Lv.15-22 Cross-Continent Guild Expedition Gateway)
hubs.hub_role: Eastern gateway terminus connected directly to Kilnwatch Bastion via Cinder Apron (Lv.12-20), where united Level 15-20 Guilds graduate from Continent 01 into the Clockwork Steppe.
guilding_and_party_features: Continent 01 -> Continent 02 Guild Expedition Charter & Root-Train Boarding
Pendulum Shaft B1 Multi-Race Party Raid Gate

phases.name: Early Growth Phase (Lv. 1–30 · Priority Focus: Lv. 1–25)

segments.title: Stage A (Lv. 1–10) · Learning Period in Racial Home Towns
segments.class_milestone: Novice / Racial Initiate (Basic Skill Usage & System Equip Tutorial)
segments.adventure_quest_tier: F-Tier Adventure Quests (Home Town Tutorial & Local Culling/Farming)
segments.equipment_unlock: Starter System Equip (Lv. 1) -> Forged Equipment + Weapon (Lv. 10) at Home Town Blacksmith Anvil
segments.skill_unlocks: Basic Attack Combo, Racial Innate Trait, and Lv. 5/10 Novice Active Skill
segments.consumable_unlocks: Minor Hearth-Herb Potion, Sweet Clover Sap (SP), Novice Warp Feather
segments.boss_milestone: Field Leader / Mini-Boss Tutorial (Lv. 8–10 Gatekeeper in adjacent Hunting Area)

segments.title: Stage B (Lv. 10–20) · Change 1st Class & All-Race Convergence Guilding
segments.class_milestone: Change 1st Class at Lv. 10 (Swordman, Mage, Archer, Acolyte, Thief/Scout, Tinker-Smith) via Job Quest
segments.adventure_quest_tier: E-Tier Adventure Quests (Cross-Race Party Commissions & Guild Registration at Kilnwatch Bastion)
segments.equipment_unlock: 1st-Class Job Armor Set & Refined Lv. 15 Alloy Gear at the Six-Anvil Foundry

early_focus_1_to_25_deep_dive.summary: Primary playable production focus covering Levels 1 to 25 (Stages A, B, and C, plus the Stage D Lv. 25–30 2nd-Class Trial bridge). Every race starts in their own Continent 01 Home Town (Lv. 1–10, Stage A), converges at Kilnwatch Bastion at Lv. 10 for 1st Class Change and Guilding (Lv. 10–20, Stage B), and tackles the first major Dungeon Raid Bosses and Lv. 20 Weapons at Lv. 20–25 (Stage C).

stage_a_1_to_10.core_experience: Learning Period: players learn basic movement, basic skill usage, System Equip tutorial, consumable item hotkeys, and complete F-Tier Adventure Quests around their race Home Town before forging their Lv. 10 Equipment + Weapon.
stage_a_1_to_10.adventure_quest_rank: F-Tier Adventure Quest (Issued at each Racial Home Town Neutral Adventure Guild desk)
stage_a_1_to_10.equipment_and_weapon_tier: Lv. 1 Starter System Equip -> Lv. 10 Racial Apprentice Weapon + Equipment Set
consumables: Novice Fly-Wing / Home Town Return Feather
skills: Racial Innate Passive + Lv. 10 Novice Capstone Skill

racial_starter_routes.lv10_weapon_forged: Lv.10 Tontatta Root-Iron Hammer / Micro-Spring Axe
Lv.10 Umbral Chime-Daggers / Eclipse Prism Scythe

stage_b_10_to_20.core_experience: Change 1st Class & All-Race Convergence: at Level 10, all 6 races travel along open highways to Kilnwatch Bastion (D06) to complete their 1st Class Change Job Quest, form cross-race Guilds (gilding), and party up for E-Tier Adventure Quests.
stage_b_10_to_20.adventure_quest_rank: E-Tier Adventure Quest (Unlocked at Lv. 10 upon registering at Kilnwatch Bastion Grand Guild Hall)
stage_b_10_to_20.equipment_and_weapon_tier: Lv. 10–15 1st-Class Job Uniform + Multi-Race Alloy Sub-Equipment
skills: Mage: Fire Bolt, Cold Bolt, Lightning Bolt
Archer: Owl Eye, Vulture Eye, Double Strafe
Thief/Scout: Double Attack, Improve Dodge, Envenom
Tinker-Smith: Mammonite Smash, Ore Discovery, Temper Weapon

stage_c_20_to_25.core_experience: First Major Boss & Lv. 20 Equipment Spike: 6-player cross-race parties take on D-Tier Adventure Quests, challenge their first full Catacomb Raid Bosses (Rank 3 Wardens), and forge Lv. 20 Weapons + Equipment sets before bridging into Continent 02.
stage_c_20_to_25.adventure_quest_rank: D-Tier Adventure Quest (Party Boss Bounties & Glaze-Barge / Pinion Terminus Escorts)
boss_encounters: Kiln-Crag Siege Golem (Raid Boss · dungeon-ember-bellows-chamber Lv. 20)
Drowned Ceramic Leviathan-Spawn (Raid Boss · dungeon-sunken-potter-hold Lv. 20)
Runaway Escapement Warden (Raid Boss · dungeon-pendulum-shaft Lv. 22–25)
stage_c_20_to_25.equipment_and_weapon_tier: New Equipment + Weapon (Lv. 20) — Boss-Core Socketed Weapons & 4-Piece Dungeon Armor Sets
skills: Mage: Fireball (AoE), Frost Diver & Soul Strike
Tinker-Smith: Cart Revolution (AoE Knockback) & Overthrust Party Buff

stage_d_25_to_30_bridge.core_experience: Prepare Change 2nd Class [Learn & Try]: players test-drive 2nd-Class trial stances in the Clockwork Steppe frontier and unlock their first Speed/Magic Booster consumables ahead of the Lv. 30 2nd-Class promotion.
stage_d_25_to_30_bridge.second_class_trial_preview: Interactive Mentor Trial Arena in Escapement Anvil & Bellows Hearth allowing players to test both 2nd-Class branches (e.g. Knight vs Crusader, Wizard vs Sage) before locking in at Level 30.
booster_consumables: Magic Booster (Amplifies MATK & Elemental Resonance for 15m)
ASPD Booster (Awakening Clock-Spring Potion · +15% Attack Speed for 15m)
skills: Trial Stance Preview Skill (Temporary 2nd-Class Signature Skill usable during Job Trial Quests)

starter_town_bindings.arrival_narrative: Awakening in Lantern Hollow (Lv.1-10), Human and Demi-Human initiates defend the First Meridian Keystone before marching east through Kiln East Orchard at Lv.10 to join all six races at Kilnwatch Bastion for guilding and party quests.

Tiny, super-strong Dwarf smith-scouts start in Root-Train Roundhouse (Lv.1-10) clearing insectoid swarms from the banyan root-railways, then ride the resin-arch line to Kilnwatch Bastion at Lv.10-20 to forge multi-race guild gear.

Ogre and Orc vanguard initiates temper their resolve at Draft-Kiln Post (Lv.1-10) in the Ash-Bellows Trench before ascending Firebrick Duct at Lv.10-20 to serve as front-line tanks for multi-race parties in Kilnwatch Bastion.

Young Furral electro-warriors train atop the wind-turbines of Cinnamon-Mill Haven (Lv.1-10), harvesting static amber before converging at Kilnwatch Bastion & Glaze-Barge Quay (Lv.10-20) to form guilds bound for their ancestral Inductor Switchyard.

Lunar star-weavers begin their pilgrimage in Porcelain Loom Sanctuary (Lv.1-10), weaving starlight wards across Celadon Causeway before uniting with all six races at Kilnwatch Bastion (Lv.10-20) to prepare for the sky-ascension to Starfall Haven.

Dark-Lunar shadow-scholars keep vigil in Carillon Hearth Belfry (Lv.1-10) listening for Demon-seal tremors in the wind-chime canyons, then join multi-race guilds at Kilnwatch Bastion & Glaze-Barge Quay (Lv.10-20) to unlock the Umbrage Prism Atolls.

long_term_governance_checklist.title: 6 Playable Races -> Canon Home Town + Hunting + Farming Loop
long_term_governance_checklist.invariant_rule: Every playable race (Human/Demi-Human, Lunar, Ogre/Orc, Dark-Lunar, Dwarf, Furral) must bind to an existing canon Town node and valid adjacent Hunting & Farming areas in the same District.
long_term_governance_checklist.evidence: All 6 playable races map to verified canon Town nodes (town-lantern-hollow, town-root-train-roundhouse, town-kilnwatch-bastion, town-inductor-switchyard, town-starfall-haven, town-umbrage-focal-sanctum) with open portals to their Hunting and Farming nodes.

long_term_governance_checklist.title: 12-Race Monster Taxonomy (6 Playable/Mob + 6 Monster-Only Ecologies)
long_term_governance_checklist.invariant_rule: All 6 Playable/Mob races (can_be_player=true, can_be_mob=true) and all 6 Monster-Only ecologies (Beast/Animal/Brute, Robotic, Undead, Fish, Insect/Arachnia, Plant with can_be_player=false, can_be_mob=true) must be registered with signature drops and continent habitats.
long_term_governance_checklist.evidence: 6/6 Playable/Mob races and 6/6 Monster-Only ecology races are defined in race_taxonomy with explicit continent habitats and crafting drops.

long_term_governance_checklist.title: 4-Chapter Canonical History & Sealed-God Causality
long_term_governance_checklist.invariant_rule: historical_epochs must contain Chapters 1.1 Creation, 1.2 Age Of The Gods, 1.3 The God Wars, and 1.4 God Seal Magic (where The Architect seals Angel, Demon, Legendary Beast, Leviathan, and the Earth/Fire/Thunder Legendary Dragon).
long_term_governance_checklist.evidence: Chapters 1.1, 1.2, 1.3, and 1.4 are canon, ordered 1..4, and link all 6 God-Tier entities and 3 regional aspects to continental scars.

long_term_governance_checklist.title: Neutral Adventure Guild ('No Side') & Cross-Racial Blacksmith Clan
long_term_governance_checklist.invariant_rule: shared_world_systems must define the Neutral Adventure Guild (allegiance='neutral_no_side') for quest trading and the Blacksmith Clan across all racial home towns.
long_term_governance_checklist.evidence: Adventure Guild charter enforces 'neutral_no_side' quest trading and Blacksmith Clan covers all 6 racial home town anvil branches.

long_term_governance_checklist.title: 3-Track Quest Loop (Main Quests + Job Quests + Side Quests)
long_term_governance_checklist.invariant_rule: shared_world_systems.quest_progression_loop must define Main Quests (God Seal narrative), Job Quests (Class & Blacksmith mastery), and Side Quests (Racial Home Town stories, hunting & farming).
long_term_governance_checklist.evidence: All 3 quest tracks (main_quest, job_quest, side_quest) are specified with clear progression roles and reward focuses.

long_term_governance_checklist.title: Strict Boss Power Hierarchy (Sealed God > MVP Apostle > Raid Boss > Mob)
long_term_governance_checklist.invariant_rule: Boss hierarchy must enforce GOD_SEALED > MVP_GOD_SUBORDINATE > RAID_BOSS > MINI_BOSS > NORMAL_MOB, where every Sealed God has a named top-tier MVP Subordinate ranked strictly above Dungeon Raid Bosses.
long_term_governance_checklist.evidence: Rank 1 (Sealed Gods) > Rank 2 (MVP Boss — Direct God Subordinate) > Rank 3 (Raid Boss — Dungeon Warden) > Rank 4 (Field Mob) is enforced across all 6 God-Tier entities.

long_term_governance_checklist.title: Lv.1-10 Same-Continent Racial Starts -> Lv.10-20 All-Race Convergence City (Guilding & Party Hub)
long_term_governance_checklist.invariant_rule: All 6 Playable Races must start on Continent 01 (Lv.1-10) in distinct canon Home Towns and have open-portal reachability to the shared Level 10-20 Convergence Hubs (Kilnwatch Bastion, Glaze-Barge Quay, Pinion Terminus) for guilding, party matchmaking, and quest trading.
long_term_governance_checklist.evidence: All 6 Playable Races start in canon Continent 01 towns (Lantern Hollow, Root-Train Roundhouse, Draft-Kiln Post, Cinnamon-Mill Haven, Porcelain Loom Sanctuary, Carillon Hearth Belfry) with verified open-portal paths into Kilnwatch Bastion (Lv.10-20 Primary Convergence Hub).

long_term_governance_checklist.title: Level 1–99 Growth Path (Stages A–L) with Lv. 1–25 Early Focus (A: 1–10, B: 10–20, C: 20–25, D: 25–30)
long_term_governance_checklist.invariant_rule: shared_world_systems.level_growth_path must define all 12 segments (A..L across Early 1–30, Middle 30–60, Late 60–99) with priority_focus_band=[1, 25] and deep-dive bindings for Stage A (Lv.1–10 F-quest + Lv.10 weapon), Stage B (Lv.10–20 1st Class + E-quest at Kilnwatch Bastion), Stage C (Lv.20–25 Boss + D-quest + Lv.20 weapon), and Stage D (Lv.25–30 Prepare 2nd Class + Magic/ASPD Boosters).
long_term_governance_checklist.evidence: All 12 growth stages (A..L) are mapped to canon Studio towns, hunting areas, and catacomb dungeons, with full Lv. 1–25 deep-dive specifications for all 6 playable races and 6 first-class jobs.

long_term_governance_checklist.title: End-to-End World Continent Area Map Chain (6 Spokes -> Kilnwatch Hub -> 3-Continent Mainline)
long_term_governance_checklist.invariant_rule: shared_world_systems.world_continent_map_chain must define verified step-by-step open-portal sequences for all 6 Stage A Racial Spokes into Kilnwatch Bastion (Stage B), both Stage C Raid & Bridge branches, the 20-node Continent 01 chain, the 22-node Continent 02 chain, the 22-node Continent 03 chain, and both inter-continental bridges.
long_term_governance_checklist.evidence: Every single adjacent pair in all 6 racial spoke chains, all 3 continental mainline chains (64 overland nodes), and both inter-continent bridges is verified to have an active open portal in content/studio/nodes/.
